1.title: Winter Is Coming

candidates.text: Six orphaned direwolf pups are found in the snow, and one is handed to each child of the northern household.
candidates.grounded_in: six orphaned dire wolf pups are found and one given to each Stark sibling

candidates.text: Across the Narrow Sea, a silver-haired exiled girl is given three fossilized dragon eggs as a wedding gift.
candidates.grounded_in: Daenerys is given three fossilized dragon eggs as a wedding gift

candidates.text: The king's whole travelling party rides north into the snowbound castle, the household lined up in the courtyard to receive them.
candidates.grounded_in: King Robert Baratheon, Ned's old friend, travels to Winterfell

1.note: As the season's first episode, no character has appeared in an earlier summary, so under the prior-characters rule all probes are written without names.

candidates.text: Tyrion Lannister rides north toward the Wall, keeping company with Jon on the long journey there.
candidates.grounded_in: Queen Cersei's younger brother, Tyrion Lannister, accompanies him on the trip

candidates.text: Catelyn stays behind at Winterfell, keeping vigil at the bedside of the still unconscious Bran.
candidates.grounded_in: Catelyn remains at Winterfell to care for the still unconscious Bran

candidates.text: Daenerys, newly wed, devotes herself to learning how to please Drogo in the marriage bed.
candidates.grounded_in: she focuses on learning how to please Drogo

candidates.text: Ned sets out down the Kingsroad for King's Landing with both his daughters, Sansa and Arya, in tow.
candidates.grounded_in: Ned, the new Hand of the King, travels to King's Landing accompanied by his daughters, Sansa and Arya

candidates.text: Jon heads north to join his uncle Benjen and take his place among the Night's Watch.
candidates.grounded_in: Jon, heads north to the Wall to join his uncle, Benjen Stark, as part of the Night's Watch

candidates.text: Ned sits in on the King's Small Council for the first time and learns how deeply the realm is in debt.
candidates.grounded_in: Ned attends the King's Small Council and learns Westeros has been poorly managed and is deeply in debt.

candidates.text: Having learned Arya kept the sword Jon gave her, Ned arranges swordsmanship lessons for her in the capital.
candidates.grounded_in: Learning that Arya aspires to be a swordsman and got a sword from Jon, he sends her to swordsmanship lessons.

candidates.text: In training at the Wall, Jon plainly outmatches the low-born recruits and convicted criminals swinging swords beside him.
candidates.grounded_in: Jon proves himself more skilled than the low-born and convicted criminals that joined the Night's Watch

candidates.text: Travelling secretly toward King's Landing, Catelyn is intercepted by a childhood friend who now sits on the council.
candidates.grounded_in: Catelyn travels to King's Landing to covertly warn her husband about the assassination attempt, but she is intercepted by her childhood friend

candidates.text: Before Tyrion rides south from the Wall, the Lord Commander asks him to beg the King for more recruits.
candidates.grounded_in: Lord Commander Jeor Mormont asks a departing Tyrion to plead with the King to send more recruits

4.title: Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things

candidates.text: Tyrion hands the Starks a sketch for a special saddle, designed so Bran can ride a horse again.
candidates.grounded_in: he presents the Starks a saddle design that will allow the paraplegic Bran to ride a horse

candidates.text: Jon steps in to shield an awkward, friendless new recruit from the beatings the other Watchmen hand out.
candidates.grounded_in: Jon takes measures to protect Samwell Tarly, an awkward and friendless Night's Watch recruit, from the other Watchmen's abuse

candidates.text: Tyrion breaks his journey south with a stop at Winterfell before continuing on to King's Landing.
candidates.grounded_in: While returning to King's Landing, Tyrion stops at Winterfell

candidates.text: Viserys, increasingly frustrated, picks a fight with his sister, who no longer meekly submits to him.
candidates.grounded_in: A frustrated Viserys clashes with his newly-empowered sister.

4.note: Several of this episode's strongest beats (the tavern encounter and its outcome, Ned's discovery) are explicitly framed as reveals or turning points, so they're excluded.

5.title: The Wolf and the Lion

candidates.text: Catelyn brings her bound Lannister prisoner up to her sister Lysa's fortress home, the Eyrie, high in the mountains.
candidates.grounded_in: Catelyn takes Tyrion prisoner at her sister Lysa Arryn's fortress home in the Eyrie.

candidates.text: Tyrion, hands tied, is marched along a narrow mountain road toward a castle perched above the Vale.
candidates.grounded_in: Catelyn takes Tyrion prisoner at her sister Lysa Arryn's fortress home in the Eyrie.

5.note: This summary is almost entirely turning points: the resignation, the news of Daenerys, the street fight and Ned's wound. Only the Eyrie arrival is usable, so two variants of it.

candidates.text: Held at the Eyrie, Tyrion demands a trial by combat rather than face Lysa's judgment.
candidates.grounded_in: In the Vale, Tyrion demands a trial by combat.

candidates.text: Bran rides out through the woods on horseback for the first time, trying out his specially built saddle.
candidates.grounded_in: Bran, while testing his new saddle

candidates.text: Ned sits the Iron Throne in Robert's absence, hearing complaints brought by petitioners from Riverrun.
candidates.grounded_in: tasks him with running affairs until Robert returns from hunting

candidates.text: Robert gathers his party and rides out of the capital for a hunting trip.
candidates.grounded_in: until Robert returns from hunting

candidates.text: Ned tells Arya and Sansa they are being sent back north to Winterfell for their own safety.
candidates.grounded_in: Ned orders Arya and Sansa return to Winterfell for their safety

7.title: You Win or You Die

candidates.text: At the Wall the recruits get their assignments: Jon and Sam are both made stewards rather than rangers.
candidates.grounded_in: Jon and Sam are assigned as stewards, with Jon as Lord Commander Jeor Mormont's personal servant

candidates.text: Jon's new duties have him waiting on Jeor Mormont personally, fetching and serving for the Lord Commander.
candidates.grounded_in: with Jon as Lord Commander Jeor Mormont's personal servant

candidates.text: Sam works out that the steward's post beside the Lord Commander is meant to prepare Jon for command.
candidates.grounded_in: with Sam believing Mormont intends to groom Jon for command

7.note: Most of this episode's summary is turning-point material (Robert's fatal hunt, the will, the throne-room betrayal, the assassin in Essos, Benjen's disappearance), so the usable texture is limited to the Night's Watch steward assignments.

8.title: The Pointy End

candidates.text: Tyrion and Bronn are ambushed on a mountain road by a band of hill tribesmen.
candidates.grounded_in: Tyrion and Bronn are ambushed by tribesmen

candidates.text: Dothraki riders sweep through a nearby settlement, roping together captured locals to be sold as slaves.
candidates.grounded_in: Drogo's soldiers begin attacking nearby settlements, enslaving locals in order to sell them

candidates.text: Robb musters the northern lords and their armies, leaving Bran behind to hold Winterfell in his place.
candidates.grounded_in: Robb hears the news and prepares the Northern armies to fight the Lannisters, leaving Bran behind to rule Winterfell

candidates.text: Catelyn rides out of her sister's mountain fortress to join her son's camp in the field.
candidates.grounded_in: Catelyn leaves to join Robb's camp

8.note: Syrio's stand in the Red Keep and the wight attack at Castle Black are the episode's most memorable images, but both are framed as deaths/turning points, so they're excluded.

9.title: Baelor

candidates.text: Jeor Mormont presents Jon with his own family's Valyrian steel sword, a gift of gratitude.
candidates.grounded_in: At the Wall, Jeor Mormont gives his family Valyrian steel sword to Jon in gratitude.

candidates.text: Catelyn goes alone into the hall of a crossing's elderly lord to bargain for passage over his land.
candidates.grounded_in: Catelyn persuades Lord Walder Frey to allow them to pass through his land

candidates.text: The Stark army halts before a castle guarding a river crossing, waiting while terms are discussed inside.
candidates.grounded_in: The Stark army arrives at the Twins castle

candidates.text: In the Dothraki camp, a slave woman insists everyone stay outside the tent while she works her blood magic.
candidates.grounded_in: Mirri tells everyone to remain outside the tent until after the spell is cast.

9.note: Most of this episode's material is turning-point or setup for it (Ned's hearing, Robb's diversion, Drogo's wound, Daenerys's labour), so the usable texture is thin.

10.title: Fire and Blood

candidates.text: A Night's Watch recruiter shears Arya's hair short so she can pass as a boy among his recruits.
candidates.grounded_in: Yoren, a Night's Watch recruiter, smuggles Arya out of King's Landing disguised as a boy

candidates.text: Jon saddles a horse in the dark and rides away alone from Castle Black.
candidates.grounded_in: Jon attempts to desert the Night's Watch

10.note: This finale's summary is almost entirely turning points (the dragons, Drogo, the secession, Tyrion's appointment), so very little inconsequential texture remains to draw on.
